content.body: The MAS.38 was a technically advanced and accurate weapon with novel features such as a recoil mechanism which actually tracked through a tube bored into the stock (thus the oddly bent look to the weapon). Its quality couldn't compensate for the sub-par 7.65mm pistol round it fired, which gave it a reputation for ineffectiveness on the battlefield.
content.brief: Type: MAS Mle.38 SMG Caliber 7.65mm Fr.Service Magazine Capacity: 32 rounds Rate of Fire: 600 rpm Muzzle Velocity: 350 m/s Included weapons: 1 x Mle.1935S pistol 4 x No.36M HE genades 4 x M18 smoke grenades 1 x combat knife
content.title: SUB MACHINE GUN INFANTRY
